stratagems.name: Kauyon
stratagems.target: One T'AU EMPIRE unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack against a unit that is within half range, re-roll the Hit roll. In addition, ranged attacks made by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

stratagems.name: Mont'ka
stratagems.target: One T'AU EMPIRE unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can Advance and still shoot this turn. In addition, until the end of the turn, subtract 1 from all Hit rolls targeting your unit.

stratagems.name: Photon Grenade
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Charge phase, just after an enemy unit declares a charge.
stratagems.target: One T'AU EMPIRE unit from your army targeted by that charge.
stratagems.effect: The charging unit suffers 1 mortal wound. In addition, until the end of the phase, your unit can fire Overwatch this turn as if it were your Shooting phase.

stratagems.name: Emergent Tunnelling
stratagems.when: Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One KROOT unit from your army that is in Reserves.
stratagems.effect: Set up that unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy models.
